create_image_as_moving_sequence: create a moving image sequence from a static image with configurable velocity and output size
build_bouncing_trajectory: build a linear trajectory with bounce-back reflection to keep coordinates in [0, 1]
create_padded_image_sequence: create a padded image sequence by shifting an image across frames with zero padding
generate_random_unit_vector: generate a random unit vector in 2D with a specified dtype for velocity initialization
summarize_moving_sequence: summarize the MovingSequence namedtuple containing image_sequence, trajectory, start_position, and velocity
